name: Wiz
description: Wiz is an AI-powered cloud security platform that connects code, cloud, and runtime data into a unified security graph to identify and remediate risk.
best_for: Security teams at enterprises running cloud-native and AI-heavy environments who need end-to-end visibility across code, cloud, and runtime.

tiers.name: Wiz Essential
tiers.notes: Published on Wiz's AWS Marketplace listing, not on wiz.io itself; wiz.io's main pricing motion is contact-sales.

cons: No public pricing on Wiz's own site -- the only vendor-published numbers live on the AWS Marketplace listing ($24K/year Essential, $38K/year Advanced per 100 workloads), and even those are described as starting points, with custom pricing via private offer for real deployments.

Licensing is modular and multi-dimensional, priced across workloads, log-ingestion volume, and sensor count as separate add-on units billed separately, so total cost is not a single number and requires stacking several unit prices.

The self-serve free trial still requires submitting a work email, phone number, job title, and company name up front -- it is lead-gen gated, not a frictionless self-serve signup, and the core product has no permanent free tier.
features: Security Graph connecting code, cloud, and runtime context
AI-specific risk identification for AI applications
